title: Kalendrath, a browser fantasy strategy game
description: Raise your city, lead your heroes, grow an empire. A heroic fantasy browser strategy game designed first for PvE.
alt_hero: A stone citadel on a rocky spur at dusk. Far off, fires burn on the plain.
pitch_lead: Three thousand years after the Sundering, the Nine Spheres are barely rising from the ashes. Raise your city, send your heroes against what stalks beyond the walls, and grow an empire.
pitch_genre: Long-form strategy and empire management in your browser, designed first for PvE and cooperation.
alt_keep: The Keep of a capital at nightfall. Before it, on a dais of black stone, the obelisk glows with violet runes.
vow1_text: An archetype, talents, gear forged by your own hand. A failure costs you time, never the hero.
alt_chapter: Stone ramparts at dusk; far off on the plain, fires burn.
vow2_text: A new server opens with each chapter, on a fixed schedule.
alt_watch: A watchtower crowned with a divination crystal, keeping watch over the valley.
vow3_title: PvP is never forced on you.
vow3_text: A peaceful player, or one without an alliance, is never crushed by someone stronger.
ages_text: Your city starts humble and changes its face as its Town Hall rises: homes multiply, defenses go up, then magic and power take hold.
alt_age1: First tier: a timber hall with a shingle roof, and the obelisk ringed by rough standing stones.
alt_age2: Second tier: a half-timbered Town Hall on a stone base; bronze rings circle the obelisk.
alt_age3: Third tier: a stone façade with great arches, a paved floor threaded with channels of light, and the same obelisk still standing.
ages_caption: The obelisk, inherited from Kaelhelm, never moves. Everything else, you build.
alt_well: A column of mana rises from a well ringed with bronze, on bare black earth.
world_p1: The world rests on the Straumar, lines of mana that run through reality like a living network.
world_p2: Millennia ago, the scholars of Kaelhelm tried to align the Straumar of several Spheres. The city vanished, the continent shattered into Shards, and the Abyss was left in its place.
world_p3: Today the hordes are stirring. You hold a human city, in the shadow of an obelisk no one yet understands.
world_link: Read the story of the world
form_title: Follow the making of the realm.
form_text: Leave your address: you will receive the project’s major news, in English, and nothing else.
form_consent: I agree to receive Kalendrath news by email. I can unsubscribe at any time.
form_legal: A confirmation email will be sent to you: without a click from you, nothing is saved. Your address is processed by Brevo, for this sole purpose. Your rights and the details of the processing:
form_done: Noted. Open the email we just sent and confirm your address: your sign-up starts there.
err_email: Enter a complete email address, for example name@example.com.
err_consent: Tick the consent box to receive our news: without it, we cannot write to you.
marks_intro: Each one is a moment when we will have something real to show. A date will be given only on the day we are sure to keep it.

marks.t: One chapter, one server, with each major version

note: The project is led by one person who does not write code and one AI that never sleeps. Both have opinions about obelisks.
foot_ai: The illustrations on this site are made with the help of generative AI (Midjourney), then chosen and reworked by the team. The project is developed in the open, with the help of an AI, on an open-source base.
